name: USW-Flex-2.5G-8
title: Switch Flex 2.5G
summary: Compact 8x 2.5GbE switch with 10G RJ45/SFP+ combo uplink, powered by USB-C or PoE+ input.

requires: UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (9.0.114+)

extra.combo: 10GbE RJ45 and SFP+ are one combo port — only one usable at a time
extra.missing_features: no LACP, IGMP snooping, 802.1X or ACLs listed; 256 VLANs

gotchas: Does not output PoE — can't power APs/cameras; it consumes PoE+.
The 10GbE RJ45 and SFP+ are a single combo uplink — one or the other, not both.
Lite feature set: no LACP, IGMP snooping or 802.1X in specs.
DIN and magnetic mounts sold separately; powering over PoE needs an 802.3at (PoE+) source.
best_for: multi-gig desk/AV cabinet off one 10G drop
